extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 3.5-inch hard disk drive, 101.6 x 147 x 26.1 mm
extras.notes: lies flat with the lid open; cast aluminium base with mirror platter, spindle clamp, read/write arm with head, voice coil magnet, parking ramp and flex cable; green PCB with baked traces on the underside, SATA data and power sockets at the rear (+Y). Movable: lid 'hard-drive_cover' (origin on the left hinge edge, opened 105 degrees, rotate +105 degrees around local Y to close) and read/write arm 'hard-drive_arm' (origin on the arm pivot, rotates around Z). No text, no logos

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
